source_references.title: Just Talk To It - the no-bs Way of Agentic Engineering
source_references.author: Peter Steinberger
source_references.evidence_scope: Describes blast-radius reasoning, small atomic commits, status checks, option gathering, and iterative hands-on verification in an agentic workflow.
source_references.notes: Source metadata and original paraphrase only; article language is not copied.

source_references.title: Shipping at Inference-Speed
source_references.author: Peter Steinberger
source_references.evidence_scope: Describes CLI-first delivery, agent-verifiable output, iterative product discovery, repository documentation, and dependency and system-design scrutiny.
source_references.notes: Source metadata and original paraphrase only; article language and configuration are not copied.

principles.statement: Start new capabilities with an executable CLI when practical so automated work can verify behavior directly before additional surfaces are added.
principles.evidence_note: The authored post explicitly describes model-and-CLI-first work as a verification loop.
context_dependencies: Agent-operated software with a useful command-line core

signature_moves.statement: Estimate change scope before editing, split work into small isolated changes, and request options when impact is uncertain.
signature_moves.evidence_note: The authored post connects blast radius to isolated commits, reversibility, and option gathering.

likely_objections.statement: When work takes materially longer than expected, stop for a status check and choose whether to redirect, abort, or continue.
likely_objections.evidence_note: The workflow explicitly uses elapsed effort as a signal to inspect progress.

anti_patterns.statement: A workflow that requires a complete idea up front can obstruct iterative discovery where hands-on feedback changes the design.
anti_patterns.evidence_note: The post describes design evolving through building and direct use.

context_dependencies: Apply to fast agent-assisted development, especially solo or small-team workflows.

abstention_boundaries.reason: The selected workflow is explicitly contextualized as primarily solo work.
The selected sources do not establish a general AI-safety doctrine.

open_questions: Which practices remain effective as teams and coordination costs grow?
